tools.name: list_question_types
tools.description: List all 22 PTE Academic question types grouped by speaking, writing, reading and listening. Returns the question type code, name, category, practice-bank size and a public practice page for each type.

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Find public PTE Academic sample questions by question type, skill category, difficulty, prediction status or keyword. Returns one representative sample per question type with its prompt, audio or image, tags, difficulty and frequency. Answer keys and explanations are not included.

tools.name: get_test_format
tools.description: Get the current PTE Academic test structure: three parts, official duration ranges, integrated skills and the question types used in each part. Useful for study plans and exam-day timing.

tools.name: get_score_requirements
tools.description: Look up PTE Academic score thresholds for Australian Competent, Proficient and Superior English, plus Temporary Graduate visa 485 component minimums. Returns current and legacy rule periods with official Home Affairs sources.
